steps.name: Arrive & breathe
steps.description: Stand tall, feet hip-width. Breathe into the belly, exhale twice as long. Let the shoulders drop.

steps.name: Neck release
steps.description: Roll the head slowly from shoulder to shoulder, chin passing the chest. Never tip it back. A small range is plenty.

steps.name: Shoulder rolls
steps.description: Roll both shoulders in big circles backwards. Switch direction halfway through.

steps.name: Big arm circles
steps.description: Straight arms circling forwards, then backwards. Calm tempo, as wide as feels good.

steps.name: Standing spine rotation
steps.description: Soften the knees, let the arms hang loose and swing the upper body left to right. The arms just come along for the ride.

steps.name: Side bends
steps.description: One arm overhead, lean to the opposite side. Alternate left and right. Keep the hips centred.

steps.name: Hip circles
steps.description: Hands on the hips, big slow circles with the pelvis. Switch direction halfway through.

steps.name: Leg swings
steps.description: Support yourself on a wall and swing one leg loosely forward and back. Switch sides after about 20 seconds.

steps.name: Knees & ankles
steps.description: Knees softly bent, circle both knees together. Then plant each foot on the toes and circle the ankle.

steps.name: Cat-cow
steps.description: On all fours. Inhale: belly drops, gaze lifts. Exhale: round the back, chin to chest. Follow your breath.

steps.name: March with arm drive
steps.description: March on the spot, knees high, arms driving. Bring the pulse up gently, never to breathless.

steps.name: Slow squat
steps.description: Feet shoulder-width, weight through the whole foot. 3 seconds down, 1 second up. Only as deep as the back stays straight.

steps.name: Push-up (wall or knees)
steps.description: Against a wall or on your knees. Body stays one line, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso. Clean and slow beats deep.

steps.name: Reverse lunge left
steps.description: Step the left leg back, lower the back knee towards the floor. Upper body upright. Touch a wall for balance if you need it.

steps.name: Reverse lunge right
steps.description: Same movement stepping the right leg back. Calm tempo, front knee stays over the foot.

steps.name: Glute bridge
steps.description: On your back, feet planted. Lift the hips until knee, hip and shoulder line up, squeeze the glutes for 2 seconds, lower slowly.

steps.name: Wall sit
steps.description: Back against the wall, knees around 90 degrees. Hold and keep breathing. Sliding higher makes it easier.

steps.name: Superman
steps.description: Lie on your front, arms forward. Lift arms and legs a few centimetres, gaze down. Hold briefly, lower, repeat.

steps.name: Standing calf raise
steps.description: Rise slowly onto the toes, hold 1 second at the top, lower deliberately slowly. Fingertips on a wall for balance.

steps.name: Forearm plank
steps.description: Elbows under the shoulders, glutes squeezed, belly tight. Do not let the hips sag. On your knees is perfectly fine.

steps.name: Side plank left
steps.description: On the left forearm, body in one line. The bottom knee may stay on the floor. Breathe calmly.

steps.name: Side plank right
steps.description: Same position on the right forearm. Actively push the hip up.

steps.name: Dead bug
steps.description: On your back, arms up, knees over the hips. Extend opposite arm and leg. The lower back stays glued to the floor.

steps.name: Bird dog
steps.description: On all fours. Extend right arm and left leg, hold 2 seconds, switch. Keep the pelvis quiet, no tipping.

steps.name: Slow bicycle
steps.description: On your back, hands resting at the temples. Bring elbow and opposite knee together slowly. Never pull on the neck.

steps.name: Hollow hold (modified)
steps.description: On your back, knees bent and lifted, shoulder blades just off the floor. Keep the lower back pressed down.

steps.name: Pelvic tilts
steps.description: On your back, feet planted. Tilt the pelvis gently forwards and backwards. Small, deliberate movement.

steps.name: 90/90 hip switch
steps.description: Seated, both knees at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side. Let the knees fall slowly from side to side.

steps.name: Deep lunge left
steps.description: Left foot forward, right knee down. Sink the hips forward, then guide the left elbow towards the inside of the foot.

steps.name: Deep lunge right
steps.description: Switch sides: right foot forward, left knee down. Same movement, keep breathing.

steps.name: Thoracic rotation left
steps.description: On all fours, left hand behind the head. Open the elbow to the ceiling, let the gaze follow. Then curl back to centre.

steps.name: Thoracic rotation right
steps.description: Same movement with the right hand behind the head. Hips stay steady over the knees.

steps.name: Downward dog to cobra
steps.description: From downward dog, sink the hips forward into a gentle cobra, then push back. Flow with the breath.

steps.name: Deep squat hold
steps.description: Feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, sink as deep as you can. Heels may lift. Elbows press the knees gently open.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.description: Knees wide, hips to the heels, arms long in front. Sink a little deeper with every exhale.

steps.name: Gentle cobra
steps.description: On your front, hands under the shoulders, lift the chest only as far as the lower back stays comfortable. Shoulders away from the ears.

steps.name: Seated forward fold
steps.description: Legs long, knees may stay softly bent. Fold from the hips with a long spine. Do not pull, just hang.

steps.name: Butterfly
steps.description: Soles of the feet together, let the knees sink. Sit tall, then lean slowly forward. Let the inner thighs go.

steps.name: Supine twist left
steps.description: On your back, drop the knees to the left, turn the head right, arms in a T. Exhale and let it sink.

steps.name: Supine twist right
steps.description: Same shape to the other side. Keep both shoulders as close to the floor as you can.

steps.name: Figure-4 left
steps.description: On your back, left ankle across the right knee, pull the right thigh towards you. Stretches the glute and deep hip.

steps.name: Figure-4 right
steps.description: Switch sides. Head and shoulders stay relaxed on the floor.

steps.name: Chest opener at the wall
steps.description: Forearm on a wall or door frame, elbow at shoulder height, turn slowly away from the arm. Switch sides halfway through.

steps.name: Neck stretch
steps.description: Sit tall, tip the head gently towards the left shoulder, right hand draws lightly towards the floor. Switch after 30 seconds.

steps.name: Legs up & final rest
steps.description: Legs up a wall, or simply lie flat. Eyes closed, nothing left to do. Long exhales, let the body get heavy.
